input.summary: Extend M&I's indemnity to M&I's breach of applicable law, M&I-caused unauthorized access to Customer data, and M&I's gross negligence or wilful misconduct; narrow Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided content and Customer's violation of law.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended M&I's indemnity and defense to M&I's violation of applicable law, M&I-caused unauthorized access to or disclosure of our data, and M&I's gross negligence or wilful misconduct, and we narrowed our own indemnity to content we supply and our own violations of law, consistent with our indemnity playbook position. The IP limb of Paragraph B and the Section 14.3 notice, control and cooperation procedures are unchanged, and "Customer" already includes our Affiliates.

ops.text: C. M&I's indemnity and defense obligations under Paragraph B shall further extend to any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) M&I's violation of applicable law, (ii) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer's data caused by M&I, and (iii) M&I's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.

ops.oldText: any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) the inaccuracy or untruthfulness of any representation or warranty made by Customer to M&I, (ii) a violation of Federal, state, or other laws or regulations for the protection of persons or members of a protected class or category of persons by Customer or its employees or agents, (iii) sexual discrimination or harassment by Customer or its employees or agents, (iv) work-related injury or death caused by Customer or its employees or agents, (v) tangible personal or real property damage or financial or monetary loss incurred by M&I resulting from Customer's acts or omissions, or those of its employees or agents and (vi) those matters included in Section 6.6(B) above.
ops.newText: any liability or expenses arising out of or relating to (i) content, data, or materials provided by Customer to M&I and (ii) Customer's violation of applicable law.
